_comment: Official listing pages checked by scripts/discover_notices.py. Add a source only after a human confirms the domain is official. allowed_domains limits which links may be reported. 'alternates' is an optional list of equivalent official URLs tried only after every attempt at 'url' fails; each alternate needs the same human confirmation, and every link it yields is still checked against allowed_domains. 'districts' is where the body's POSTS are, not where its office is: the publisher copies it onto every card, so a pan-India body says ["All India"] and never silently becomes a West Bengal job.
